detail.longDescription: Please share this one out, and complete if you haven't already! Really keen to get responses from under-represented regions (Latin America, Africa, Middle East, South-East Asia). What sounds are meaningful to you? That speak to a particular place that you may have lived? That you consider culturally important? We're running a survey to record some of these, and would love for you to contribute! It is short - < 5 minutes, and all responses are gratefully received. The sounds only have to be meaningful to 'you', and it doesn't matter what they are, Please share widely - Multilingual versions are available, and more are being added. https:// marianajlopez.com/enhancing-au dio-description/sound-heritage-survey/ # sounds # research # culture # heritage
